Registration fee: R$ 20,00
As the venue has a limited size, it will be permitted a single guest per competitor, without any possibility of the addition of other guests.
Competitor limit: 20

REGISTRO
A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos, sem o cumprimento destes, a inscrição não será aceita:

Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA;
Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (matcasvia@gmail.com) indicando o nome completo do participante. Detalhes sobre o pagamento da inscrição abaixo.

Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro.
Há um limite de 20 competidores
Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (matcasvia@gmail.com).

REGISTRATION
The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements, without fulfilling these requirements, the registration will not be accepted:

Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (matcasvia@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name. More details about the payment below;

Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned.
There will be a limit of 20 competitors.
For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (matcasvia@gmail.com)

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYwNTgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3aa05b1024ee2e9271b7b0bd5d799771742bd090/IZCALLI%201%202%203%20(2).png)

#### BIENVENIDOS A LA PRIMER PARADA DE LA RUTA CUBERA 2025, IZCALLI CLÁSICO
Después de 6 años México regresa a tener una ruta cubera, por 3 ciudadades alrededor del país, siendo la primera Cuautitlán Izcalli en el Estado de México, con nuestro querido torneo Clásico!
Habrá sorpresas para todos aquellos que completen la Ruta Cubera 2025, así que no dejes que se te vaya la primer parada, prepara tus mejores 3x3 y 2x2, te esperamos en Izcalli!.

Un agradecimiento especial a las FES-Cuautitlán UNAM por las facilidades y apoyo para realizar este evento, y al Team Izcalli por el compromiso para poderlo llevar a cabo.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia.[](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

#### WELCOME TO THE FIRST STOP OF THE CUBER ROUTE 2025, IZCALLI CLASICO
After 6 years, Mexico returns to have a cuba route, through 3 cities around the country, the first being Cuautitlán Izcalli in the State of Mexico, with our beloved Classic tournament!
There will be surprises for all those who complete the Cuber 2025 Route, so don't let the first stop pass you by, prepare your best 3x3 and 2x2, we are waiting for you in Izcalli!

We thank the FES-Cuautitlán UNAM for the facilities and support to hold this event and to the izcalli team for the commitment to be able to carry it out.

This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the WCA regulations before the competition. [](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)

### **IMPORTANTE**
Es obligatorio revisar [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) para comprender las normas y procedimientos que se realizaran en el torneo.
​
* Revisar la pestaña [¿Cómo pagar?](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LosReyesdelCuboChiclayoIII2025#53273-como-pagar-how-to-pay) para conocer los medios de pago.
* Revisar la pestaña [Horario](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LosReyesdelCuboChiclayoIII2025#competition-schedule) para conocer el cronograma del torneo.
* Para **Registrarte** al torneo hacer click en [Registrarse](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LosReyesdelCuboChiclayoIII2025/register)
* Asimismo, se les recomienda revisar estos videos para tener una noción mas clara de como se llevará a cabo el torneo.
* [Tutorial para competidores nuevos - Jael Riggenbach](https://www.facebook.com/100000565031843/videos/3156907307906324/)
* [Cómo competir en un torneo WCA - Reglas básicas - ASA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFCBh3i7TiY)
* Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID.
 
### **IMPORTANT**
  You must check [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to understand the rules and procedures to be followed during the tournament.
  
*  Check [How to pay](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LosReyesdelCuboChiclayoIII2025#53273-como-pagar-how-to-pay) to know the payment methods.

*   To **Register** to the competition click [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LosReyesdelCuboChiclayoIII2025/register)
*   We also recommend that you review this video to have a clearer notion of how the competition will be conducted.
[WCA Competitor Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww)
* It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

Battle For Belgrade 2025 je dvadeset i treće po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. 

**Ovo takmičenje će se razlikovati od uobičajenih takmičenja koja smo do sada organizovali. Takmičari će biti podeljeni u 2 tima i zajedno će pokušati da ostvare što veći broj poena da bi osvojili nagrade. Pročitajte detaljnije o konceptu takmičenja** [ovde.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BattleForBelgrade2025#52904-battle-for-belgrade-koncept-battle-for-belgrade-concept)

------------------------

(ENG)

Battle For Belgrade 2025 is the 23rd speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. 

**This competition will be different from the ones we are usually organizing. Competitors will be divided into 2 teams, and will work together to try and achieve as many points as possible. Read more about the competition's concept** [here.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BattleForBelgrade2025#52904-battle-for-belgrade-koncept-battle-for-belgrade-concept)
